notes: וְלֹא is the ordinary rule 35 fusion into *nor*, headed on the negative, which is what distinguishes it from a bare *and*.
The first לֹא is written after its verb, so its unit is discontinuous under rule 25.
לְ before אֱלֹהִים goes unrepresented because the ASV recasts the clause with a bare English object, *charged God* (rule 40).
